description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


📖 Read the announcement blog post: https://tabularis.dev/blog/v0300-tabularis-web-result-charts-scheduled-backups?utm_src=github-release
See the assets below to download this version and install.
🐳 Self-host in the browser: docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v tabularis-data:/data ghcr.io/tabularisdb/tabularis:0.30.0 (see the container guide).
🛡️ Security: fixes GHSA-9x4c-wq7x-5fjq (MCP database argument). Users of v0.29.0 should upgrade.
